ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Svchost Process Access
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious access to the "svchost" process such as that used by Invoke-Phantom to kill the thread of the Windows event logging service. Note: Unmapped fields: TargetImage, GrantedAccess, CallTrace, SourceImage

sequences.query: (TargetImage = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") AND GrantedAccess = "0x1F3FFF" AND CallTrace = RGX(".*UNKNOWN.*")) AND  NOT ((SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Visual\\ Studio\\\\.*") AND SourceImage = RGX("\\\\MSBuild\\\\Current\\\\Bin\\\\MSBuild\\\.exe$") AND (CallTrace = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\.Build\\\.ni\\\.dll.*") OR CallTrace = RGX(".*System\\\.ni\\\.dll.*"))))
